user.title: SAIA S-Bus Setup
user.description: Select the S-Bus protocol variant for your SAIA PCD controller.

data_description.protocol_type: Choose the S-Bus protocol variant based on your connection type

ether_sbus.title: Ether-S-Bus Configuration
ether_sbus.description: Configure connection via Ether-S-Bus (UDP/TCP over Ethernet).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the SAIA PCD controller
data_description.station: S-Bus station address of the target device
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the device for updates

serial_sbus.title: Serial-S-Bus Configuration
serial_sbus.description: Configure connection via Serial-S-Bus (RS-232/RS-485 or TCP serial bridge). For serial port: e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0. For TCP serial bridge: e.g., 192.168.1.100:5050

data_description.serial_port: Serial port path (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0) or TCP address (host:port)
data_description.station: S-Bus station address of the target device
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the device for updates

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Profibus gateway
data_description.port: TCP port of the Profibus gateway
data_description.station: S-Bus station address of the target device
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the device for updates

discovery_confirm.title: Discovered SAIA PCD Device

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SAIA S-Bus
reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings for your SAIA PCD controller.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Please check host, port and connection settings.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid station address or device not responding.
error.timeout: Connection timeout. Please check your network connection and device availability.
error.crc_error: CRC validation error. Data corruption detected.
error.serial_port_not_found: Serial port not found. Please check the port path and permissions.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Please check the logs.
error.cannot_connect_tcp: The device refused the TCP connection or did not respond. Ether-S-Bus normally runs over UDP – please choose UDP as connection type.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the PCD

add_register.title: Add register
add_register.description: Creates a sensor for a PCD register. Value = raw value × factor.

data_description.factor: e.g. 0.1 if the PCD stores 32.5 °C as 325
data_description.unit: Pick a unit or type your own; °C, kWh, W … set the matching sensor type

data_description.factor: e.g. 0.1 if the PCD stores 32.5 °C as 325

data_description.writable: On: switch that can set/reset the flag. Off: read-only binary sensor

import_project.title: Import PG5 project
import_project.description: Upload the Fupla file (e.g. HKLS.fup) and the linker map (Lst/<project>.map) of the PG5 project that runs on the PCD. Build the project first so the map is current. Only the evaluated data point list is stored. {error}

import_done.title: Project imported

select_group.title: Choose plant
select_group.description: Numbers: operating values / all data points.

data.parameters: Also show settings and commissioning parameters

select_points.title: Data points of {group}
select_points.description: {count} data points. Ticked ones become entities; ✎ = adjustable (number entity or switch). Removing the tick removes the entity.

error.invalid_project: The files could not be read as PG5 project.
error.upload_failed: The uploaded files could not be read.
error.empty_project: No registers or flags with an address found. Is the map from the same build as the Fupla file?

read_register.name: Read Register
read_register.description: Read one or more registers from the S-Bus device.

write_register.name: Write Register
write_register.description: Write a value to a register on the S-Bus device.

value.name: Value
value.description: The value to write (32-bit integer or float).

read_flag.name: Read Flag
read_flag.description: Read flag (bit) values from the S-Bus device.

write_flag.name: Write Flag
write_flag.description: Write a flag (bit) value on the S-Bus device.
